name: @local/dsh-workflow-model-guard
description: Extend the subagent model-selection allow-list to the workflow tool: a system-prompt section that appears only while the workflow tool is mounted, and a tools/pre-execute gate that denies a workflow script asking for an off-list provider/model route.

meta.title: 工作流子智能体模型护栏
meta.description: 把「子智能体」插件里设置的「允许选择的模型」白名单也管到 workflow 这条路上：workflow 工具挂载时向系统提示词注入一段「先查 list_subagent_models、只从授权路由里选」的指导（软），并在 tools/pre-execute 拦截 workflow 调用、静态读出脚本里 agent() 指定的 provider/model，越权则 deny 且 reason 里点名非法路由、列出允许路由并给出两条出路（硬）。
